citation.title: Edge electron density profiles and fluctuations measured by two-dimensional beam emission spectroscopy in the KSTAR
citation.authors: Y. U. Nam; S. Zoletnik; M. Lampert; Á. Kovácsik; H. M. Wi

topic: KSTAR 2D BES upgrade (32-channel APD array, 2 MHz sampling, roughly 1 cm resolution) and edge density and fluctuation behavior across L-H transitions, ELMs and H-L back transitions
own_question: Can the upgraded, low-background BES provide relative edge density profiles and fluctuation patterns for fast transient events?
actual_method_and_evidence: Instrument description and a few case studies. The data come from 2013-era shots #9163 and #9420-9422, not KSTAR2022. Stray-light blocking reduced background from about 30% to 2%. Photon intensity is treated as a proxy for relative ne without calibration. Fluctuation profiles are band-averaged autopower spectra computed over 20 ms windows. The paper gives a qualitative description of an ELM precursor and its phase delays, with a rough poloidal velocity and wavenumber estimate. It has no Te or Ti, no CES, no prediction, and no statistics across shots.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR BES measures edge density fluctuations with 2D APD channels at MHz sampling near the pedestal. The raw intensity mainly tracks relative electron density.
claim_checks.qualification: This describes the 2014 hardware. It reflects the source authors' assumption that other parameters are subordinate. It is a relative signal, not calibrated ne, and it does not describe the 2022 configuration.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Edge BES signals change around confinement transitions and ELM precursors. This motivates BES as possibly informative auxiliary input about edge state.
claim_checks.qualification: The evidence is a small number of single-shot qualitative observations. The authors' interpretations, such as the claim that mid-frequency fluctuations play an important role in the L-H transition, are suggestive rather than demonstrated. The figures were not visually checked.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: BES only, sampled at 2 MHz. The paper uses 0.1 ms intensity averages and 20 ms fluctuation windows. It has no CES targets and contains no information about report timing.
validation_if_relevant: None. There is no held-out data and no quantitative validation.
forbidden_inferences: BES predicts or informs CES carbon-impurity Ti, or electron temperature
the 2014 resolution and background values apply to KSTAR2022 data
the source demonstrates the physical mechanism of the L-H transition
the source involves real-time or online use
the 10 ms snapshots used in our study preserve the fluctuation content analyzed here
this source is representative of all prior BES work
reason_to_include_or_exclude: It is a suitable background citation for the KSTAR BES instrument and its sensitivity to edge transients. It gives no evidence about temperature nowcasting.
